Style reference images are the viewed cream wooden fence with emerald green pointed caps and golden roof ranch: preserve this warm ivory/emerald palette but redesign every piece with very thick crisp near-black NAVY contour, long perfectly straight sections, sharp 45-degree chamfers and angular polygon flat cel shadows. Each material ONLY base color plus one sharply bounded shadow, no grain, NO gradients, no airbrush, NO 3D. This is ranch craftsmanship, no beach ropes, no sea, no characters, no symbols, no text, no gridlines. FOUR SEPARATE COMPONENTS in generous 2 by 2 quadrants, actual alpha0 gutters around everything, no overlap: TOP LEFT a long HORIZONTAL CONTINUOUS open wooden fence rail carrier, TWO parallel warm ivory planks separated by a transparent gap, four times longer than tall, clean long straight flat planks with dark navy outlines along long edges; no posts, no poles, no fasteners near either end, no rails broken into panels; side ends are square cropped open connector ends. TOP RIGHT an independently drawn VERTICAL CONTINUOUS fence carrier, TWO parallel warm ivory planks running vertically, long straight edges, transparent central gap, no end posts or caps; top and bottom are clean square connector ends. BOTTOM LEFT one isolated UPRIGHT small cream timber fence post with bold emerald-green faceted pointed cap and angular green foot block, frontal tiny top view, short front face, thick navy outline, no projecting rails, no shadow puddle. BOTTOM RIGHT a second isolated small diamond-cut emerald joint block, compact rectangular construction, no arms. Large simple graphic masses. All components fully visible with large empty gutters. Need long rail carriers to join seamlessly across multiple game cells, never one closed rectangle per cell.
